guide: Open Start and type your business name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the target income per hour, the plan hours of a visit, the highest mileage share and the date of your price list.
Check Packages, Pay rates, Areas and Local price range. They hold the prices, planned hours, shift rates, mileage rates and your own local range that the other sheets read.
Paste your finished clients into Actual hours by client: prenatal, on-call contact, birth and postpartum hours and the mileage cost, taken from your logs.
Keep Contracts and Add-ons sold up to date. Package profit, Package mix by month and Package sales by month count from them.
Read Package profit first: it ranks every package by income per hour and checks it against your target and your local range.
Use Bundle test, Discount effect and Add-on attach to see what the combined packages, the discounts and the add-ons do to your income.
Open Hours plan vs actual and Mileage by package to find a package whose plan hours or travel cost is wrong.
Use Postpartum price per hour to compare each hour pack with the shift rates, and Price list with discounts to write the next list.
Run the 18 calculators before you change a price, a discount, a pack or a package: each ends in a clear verdict and has a what-if grid.
Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
A solo doula can use the same sheets with one doula and no backup rota: keep one row in each doula list.
Read the Package Profit Dashboard and the charts every month: income per hour, plan against actual hours, mileage, discounts and add-ons.

listing.headline: Know what every package really earns for each hour you give
listing.description:
Price a doula business from the hours it really takes. Built for an owner-doula who runs a small agency or works alone, with packages for birth, postpartum hours and a combined package. Package profit sets every package against the prenatal, on-call, birth and postpartum hours of your finished clients and the mileage cost, ranks them from the lowest income per hour and checks each against your own target and your own local price range.

Bundle test compares a combined package with the birth package and the postpartum pack it is made of. Discount effect shows what the community rate and the returning-client discount give up each quarter. Add-on attach shows how often each add-on sells. Hours plan vs actual finds a package whose planned hours are wrong, Mileage by package shows where a travel fee is due and Postpartum price per hour sets every hour pack against your shift rates.

18 calculators answer the questions you ask each week: which package earns the least, is the price right, does the bundle pay, keep or drop an add-on, the break-even price, the pack ladder, the discount ceiling, a travel fee, a new package, next year's price plan and a 3-month sales forecast. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to clients, enquirers, the owner-doula, doulas, the admin, the accountant and a photographer.

This is part two of the Doula Business suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Clients appear by name, package, doula and dates only, with no medical detail, and the sheets count hours, dates and money, never outcomes. Prices and targets are your own settings: confirm tax and local rules with your adviser.
